name: WFP-Attention
description: Review — the three control checks: Positions holding more FTE than they have (Over-filled), people over 1.0 FTE across Positions (Over-booked), and anyone in a Position that does not exist that month (Person In Closed Position). Reads the rules directly; they have no feeders, so the month totals are read first, then only the months that trip.
title: 6 Needs attention
